candidates.name: Codebase context bake-off
candidates.problem_to_solve: Coding agents repeatedly spend tokens, tool calls and latency rediscovering framework architecture and dependency relationships.
stage_a_success_criteria: each external arm runs against the same deterministic fixture
no provider/model credential required
no checked-out framework repository write
no global or agent configuration write
no persistent daemon or watcher
preregistered fixture symbols and call-chain facts are recoverable
result is bound to package version, observed source SHA and fixture hash
stage_a_failure_criteria: candidate requires agent wiring or persistent process
unexpected provider/model call or telemetry requirement
fixture architecture facts cannot be recovered reproducibly
package cannot be installed at the frozen version
candidates.stage_b_promotion_gate: At least 20 frozen representative framework engineering tasks. The winning external arm must reduce exploration cost by at least 20 percent without a correctness regression, architecture misunderstanding, protected-path regression or unacceptable complexity/security tax. Only one external arm may win. If neither clearly beats baseline after complexity tax, retire both.
rollback_criteria: remove isolated adapter/harness and external package from the Lab environment; no production rollback required

candidates.name: Inspect AI agent and skill evaluation harness
candidates.problem_to_solve: The framework has strong bespoke tests but lacks a standardized external agent-evaluation harness for reproducible task, scorer and sandbox comparisons.
stage_a_success_criteria: pinned Inspect package imports successfully
Task, Sample and deterministic scorer contracts can be constructed locally
no model or provider call is made
no checked-out framework repository write
no remote sandbox is required
result is bound to package version and observed source SHA
stage_a_failure_criteria: basic local task/scorer construction is unstable
package cannot be installed at the frozen version
candidates.stage_b_promotion_gate: Demonstrate materially better reproducibility, discriminatory power, failure localization or auditability than the existing in-house test stack on frozen candidate tasks, with no reduction of the framework's protected-path and clean-tree guardrails and acceptable complexity tax.
rollback_criteria: delete the isolated Inspect adapter and Lab dependency; preserve native framework tests and guardrails

candidates.name: Promptfoo adversarial skill red-team harness
candidates.problem_to_solve: Functional success tests may not expose prompt injection, authority escalation, secret-access, evidence-tampering or tool-abuse failure modes in new agent/skill candidates.
stage_a_success_criteria: pinned Promptfoo CLI validates the local frozen configuration
echo provider only in Stage A
telemetry, update checks, sharing and remote generation disabled
no provider/model credential required
no target or red-team execution performed
no checked-out framework repository write
result is bound to package version and observed source SHA
stage_a_failure_criteria: provider/model credential required for config validation
package cannot be installed at the frozen version
candidates.stage_b_promotion_gate: On a preregistered adversarial suite, detect meaningful authority-escalation, prompt-injection, secret-access, protected-path mutation, self-promotion, evidence-tampering or provenance-corruption failures not caught by the current baseline, with acceptable false-positive rate and complexity tax.
rollback_criteria: remove Promptfoo adapter/config and Lab dependency; retain native framework security gates

reference_only.reason: pattern library only; broad persona count does not establish independent information or justify runtime complexity
source-access pattern only; scraping, cookie and platform-fragility surface is not justified for current framework needs
parallel worktree and blind-adjudication pattern may inspire a future experiment, but no dependency is justified now
